items.headline: Council to take second vote on LinkedIn development agreement amendment
items.summary: The City Council's October 27 agenda lists the second reading of an amendment to the LinkedIn development agreement covering 700-810 East Middlefield Road and 1100-1200 Maude Avenue. A second reading is the final step before an ordinance takes effect.

items.headline: Council to consider tax-exempt bond financing for 334 San Antonio Road housing
items.summary: On October 27, the City Council is scheduled to consider multi-family housing tax-exempt bond financing for a development at 334 San Antonio Road.

items.headline: Council to review design concept for SR 237/Middlefield interchange
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled on October 27 to consider the design concept for Project 19-65, interchange improvements at State Route 237 and Middlefield Road.

items.headline: Council to weigh bidder pre-qualification for new Public Safety Building
items.summary: The October 27 agenda includes pre-qualification of responsible bidders and subcontractors for the Public Safety Building (Project 20-49). The council is also scheduled to consider adopting a Public Art Strategy at the same meeting.

items.headline: Council closed session lists City Attorney appointment and pay negotiations
items.summary: The City Council's 5:15 p.m. closed session on October 27 lists a public employee appointment for City Attorney. It also lists a conference with labor negotiators on the City Attorney, who is an unrepresented employee.

items.headline: Sunnyvale duplex at 536 Hawthorn Avenue could become three townhomes
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 26 study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish the existing 1,360-square-foot duplex on a 0.29-acre R-3 lot at 536 Hawthorn Avenue. In its place, one two-story building would hold three townhome-style condominiums, and the parcel would be subdivided into three lots. The agenda listed a use permit and tentative parcel map; it did not record any outcome.

items.headline: Request to delay citywide residential parking rules rewrite to Nov. 9
items.summary: The October 26 Planning Commission agenda listed a request to continue to November 9, 2026, a proposed ordinance that would repeal and replace Sunnyvale's zoning parking chapter (19.46). It would also amend the Downtown, Lawrence Station, and El Camino Real specific plan chapters, the definitions chapter, and the Dual Urban Opportunity Housing chapter. The commission would forward a recommendation to the City Council on the residential off-street parking requirements.

items.headline: Seven-unit condo building permitted at 1141 W San Carlos Street
items.summary: A permit was issued for Building 3 of the Foundry condo project at 1141 W San Carlos Street, with a permit valuation of $2,116,142. The source reports 7 dwelling units for this new condo building.
